election_dates.primarySnippet: N.J.S.A. 19:2-1: Primary elections for delegates and alternates to national conventions of political parties and for the general election shall be held in each year on the Tuesday next after the first Monday in June between the hours of 6:00 A.M. and 8:00 P.M., Standard Time.
election_dates.generalSnippet: N.J.S.A. 19:2-3: General and special elections. The general election shall be held on the Tuesday next after the first Monday in November in each year.

state_background_check.value: No — New Jersey has no blanket felony-disqualification rule for elective office; its only relevant statute permanently bars someone from future office only if they were convicted of an offense that involved or touched the specific state or local office they already held, and by its own text that bar reaches only offices "under this State or any of its administrative or political subdivisions," not federal office
state_background_check.snippet: N.J.S.A. 2C:51-2(d): "In addition to the punishment prescribed for the offense, and the forfeiture set forth in subsection a. of N.J.S.2C:51-2, any person convicted of an offense involving or touching on his public office, position or employment shall be forever disqualified from holding any office or position of honor, trust or profit under this State or any of its administrative or political subdivisions."

primary_results.snippet: Incumbent Robert Menendez Jr., Craig Honts, Da'Shone Hughey, and Aristotle Eliopoulos are running in the general election for U.S. House New Jersey District 8 on November 3, 2026. Honts and Eliopoulos have no FEC 2026 registration found. A same-surname FEC record (his father, former Sen. Robert Menendez Sr., convicted of corruption in 2024) is a confirmed different person and was not used; see code comment.

bio_summary.value: Da'Shone Hughey (We The People Party) is running for election to the U.S. House to represent New Jersey's 8th Congressional District . He is on the ballot in the general election on November 3, 2026 .

high_school.snippet: graduated from the Hudson School, Hoboken, N.J., 2003

civic_affiliations.value: member of the Port Authority of New York and New Jersey board of commissioners, 2021-2022
civic_affiliations.snippet: member of the Port Authority of New York and New Jersey board of commissioners, 2021-2022

marital_status.value: Married to Jane Jacobsen (1976-2005, divorced); married to Nadine Arslanian (2020)

platform.value: Is fighting to protect Medicaid and defend the care millions rely on, opposing what he calls the largest cut to Medicaid and ACA protections in history
platform.snippet: As a member of the House Energy and Commerce Committee, I am fighting back alongside House to protect Medicaid and defend the care millions rely on.

platform.value: Wants to build on the ACA's coverage expansion, cost reductions, and pre-existing condition protections rather than roll them back
platform.snippet: We should be building on landmark legislation like the ACA which took critical steps to lower costs, expand coverage for underinsured and uninsured populations, and ensure Americans cannot be denied coverage due to pre-existing conditions, instead of making it harder for people to access care.

platform.value: Committed to finding solutions to the nation's healthcare challenges that prioritize patients and lower costs for American families
platform.snippet: I am committed to finding effective solutions to our nation’s healthcare challenges that prioritize patients and lower costs for American families.

platform.value: As the grandson of Cuban refugees, will conduct legal oversight of detention facilities and stand up for immigrant neighbors
platform.snippet: As the proud grandson of Cuban refugees, I will continue to stand up for all of our neighbors, conduct legal oversight of detention facilities, and fight back against this Administration’s attempts to undermine the rights of everyone who calls this country home.

platform.value: Wants longstanding solutions including a pathway to citizenship, fair immigration laws, robust asylum protections, closing private detention centers, and expanded immigration court capacity
platform.snippet: We must develop real, longstanding solutions for the challenges that plague America’s broken immigration system, including a pathway to citizenship, fair immigration laws, robust asylum protections, closing private detention centers, and expanded capacity to address our national immigration court backlog.

platform.value: As Vice Chair for Policy of the Congressional Hispanic Caucus, focused on protecting immigrant communities and enacting border security policies that are humane and effective
platform.snippet: As Vice Chair for Policy for the Congressional Hispanic Caucus, I am focused on protecting our immigrant communities and enacting border security policies that are humane, effective, and reflective of our values as a nation.

platform.value: Introduced the Working Families Task Force Act to bring together federal officials to work on affordability, child care access and wage growth
platform.snippet: I introduced the Working Families Task Force Act, which will bring together officials from across the federal government to work on solutions for the issues impacting working families, including affordability, access to childcare, and wage growth.

platform.value: As a founding member of the Dads Caucus, introduced the Parental Workforce Training Act establishing a federal pilot program to help parents afford child care while in workforce training
platform.snippet: And as a founding member of the Dads Caucus, I introduced the Parental Workforce Training Act, legislation establishing a federal pilot program to help parents afford childcare while enrolled in workforce training.

platform.value: Is an original co-sponsor of the Richard L. Trumka Protecting the Right to Organize Act to strengthen organized labor
platform.snippet: I am also proud to be an original co-sponsor of the Richard L. Trumka Protecting the Right to Organize Act, which will strengthen organized labor and provide 21st century tools that unions need to give workers the wages and rights they deserve

platform.value: Is an original co-sponsor of the Raise the Wage Act to increase the federal minimum wage
platform.snippet: as well as the Raise the Wage Act, which will provide for increases to the Federal minimum wage.

platform.value: On the House Energy and Commerce Committee, has voted against cuts to climate and energy programs and against anti-environment bills
platform.snippet: On the House Energy and Commerce Committee, I’ve voted against harmful cuts to key climate and energy programs and anti-environment bills that would raise costs for our families and makeour planet less livable.

platform.value: Fighting for a clean energy economy that keeps costs low, creates good-paying jobs, and ensures frontline communities share in and lead the transition to net-zero
platform.snippet: I am fighting for a clean energy economy that keeps costs low, generates good paying jobs, reduces our dependence on extractive industries, and ensures that frontline communities share in and lead our transition to net-zero.

platform.value: Says funding for the Gateway Program -- the largest infrastructure project in the country, running through the district -- must be maintained and the project completed on time, and has led efforts in the House to hold the Trump Administration accountable for withholding that funding for partisan purposes
platform.snippet: It is essential that funding for Gateway is maintained and the project is completed on-time. That's why I've led efforts in the House to hold the Trump Administration accountable for its efforts to needlessly withhold that funding for partisan purposes.

platform.value: Advocating for the National Park Service and FAA to designate Liberty State Park as an avoidance area for helicopter traffic
platform.snippet: I am also fighting the negative impacts that helicopter noise pollution has had on many areas of our communities by advocating for the National Park Service (NPS) and the FAA to designate Liberty State Park as an avoidance area for helicopter traffic and by introducing the Communities Before Air Tourism Act.

platform.value: Introduced the Protecting Communities from Helicopter Noise Act and the Communities Before Air Tourism Act to reduce the number of helicopter flights in the New York-New Jersey metropolitan area
platform.snippet: I introduced the Protecting Communities from Helicopter Noise Act and the Communities Before Air Tourism Act, which aim to reduce the number of helicopter flights in the New York-New Jersey metropolitan area.

platform.value: Introduced bipartisan legislation in the 119th Congress banning all non-essential helicopter traffic within a 20-mile radius of the Statue of Liberty
platform.snippet: During the 119th Congress, I introduced bipartisan legislation, the Improving Helicopter SafetyAct, which bans all non-essential helicopter traffic within a 20-mile radius of the Statue of Liberty.
